notes.title: Ninja Ordinance is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/4a5f2afd6552a4b2cb195a7019b59742712e6021.png

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Ninja Ordinance, developed by OneCoin! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070620/Ninja_Ordinance

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=ctyZUSOeTY4;full][/previewyoutube]

Join Momijimaru, an elite ninja on a mission of survival in this Stealth ARPG! Sneak past enemies and strike from the shadows—or confront them head-on with a decisive blow! But beware, one wrong move can lead our agent of shadows into many precarious situations!

More from us:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070600/Senpai_and_the_Mysterious_Island/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762940/Ninja_Infiltration/
